questions.question: Aaron's sons Nadab and Abihu offered fire before the LORD exactly as He had commanded them. True or false?
When Moses explained what the LORD meant by the deaths of Nadab and Abihu, how did their father Aaron respond?

answers.text: He cried out to the LORD

questions.question: What did the LORD tell Aaron and his sons, the priests, not to do when they entered the Tent of Meeting?
Why did the LORD want Aaron and his sons to know the holy from the common and the clean from the unclean?

answers.text: So they could teach the Israelites His statutes
So they could settle disputes between the tribes
So they could count the people of each tribe
